## Motivation

Is an earlier flight worth the early alarm? We will examine whether morning flights arrive late less often, how much of any advantage remains within comparable routes, and whether it varies across airports and seasons. Cancellations and diversions will help assess whether the answer changes when unsuccessful trips are included.
